episodes.name: The Mutiny (1)
episodes.overview: Rita Repulsa's minions abandon her when an even more evil menace arrives on the Moon.

episodes.name: The Mutiny (2)
episodes.overview: Lord Zedd steals the power of the Zords away from the Rangers.

episodes.name: The Mutiny (3)
episodes.overview: The Power Rangers obtain new Zords to defeat Pirantishead.

episodes.name: The Wanna-Be Ranger
episodes.overview: Lord Zedd attacks with a monster that can morph from one Power Ranger to another.

episodes.name: Putty on the Brain
episodes.overview: Lord Zedd casts a spell on the Power Rangers.

episodes.name: Bloom of Doom
episodes.overview: Kimberly is attacked by the Bloom of Doom, a poisonous plant.

episodes.name: The Green Dream
episodes.overview: Goldar plans to steal Tommy's Green Ranger powers.

episodes.name: The Power Stealer
episodes.overview: While cleaning up Angel Grove, the teens get trapped by the Octophantom monster who attempts to drain the Rangers of their powers.

episodes.name: The Beetle Invasion
episodes.overview: The Stag Beetle Monster drains Tommy's powers in an attack on Angel Grove.

episodes.name: Welcome to Venus Island
episodes.overview: Rangers face Monster Venus Fly Traps as they try to rescue Hallie from Lord Zedd's island stronghold.

episodes.name: The Song of Guitardo
episodes.overview: Kimberly is the only one who can save the Rangers from a musical spell.

episodes.name: Green No More (1)
episodes.overview: A giant Turban Shell captures Tommy and transports him to Zedd's Otherworld.

episodes.name: Green No More (2)
episodes.overview: Tommy attempts to retrieve the Rangers' Morphers and escape from Zedd's Otherworld.

episodes.name: Missing Green
episodes.overview: Jason's guilt of Tommy's loss of power causes even more problems for the Power Rangers.

episodes.name: Orchestral Maneuvers in the Park
episodes.overview: The Power Rangers must toot their own horns to stop Lord Zedd's Trumpet Top.

episodes.name: Beauty and the Beast
episodes.overview: Kimberly is captured and transformed into Lord Zedd's evil queen.

episodes.name: White Light (1)
episodes.overview: Alpha and Zordon go on a secret mission, leaving the Power Rangers to fend for themselves.

episodes.name: White Light (2)
episodes.overview: Zordon introduces the team to the new White Ranger and his mighty White Tiger Zord.

episodes.name: Two for One
episodes.overview: Lord Zedd fashions unfeminine monsters from Kimberly's stolen purse.

episodes.name: Opposites Attract
episodes.overview: Lord Zedd plans to steal Billy's magnetic polarizing gauge and wreak havoc with the Earth's gravitational pull.

episodes.name: Zedd's Monster Mash
episodes.overview: Tommy faces some real Halloween monsters after he's kidnapped by Goldar.

episodes.name: The Ninja Encounter (1)
episodes.overview: Lord Zedd tries to recruit winners of a Ninja Tournament to his cause, but the Rangers have other plans.

episodes.name: The Ninja Encounter (2)
episodes.overview: The Power Rangers attempt to save their young ninja friends from the clutches of Lord Zedd.

episodes.name: The Ninja Encounter (3)
episodes.overview: Billy must risk revealing his real identity to save his new ninja friends.

episodes.name: A Monster of Global Proportions
episodes.overview: Lord Zedd tries to sabotage the first World Teen Summit.

episodes.name: Zedd Waves
episodes.overview: Beamcaster controls the minds of Angel Grove's citizens, turning them into Zedd's Zombies.

episodes.name: The Power Transfer (1)
episodes.overview: The Rangers must stop Zedd as he unleashes an awesome new weapon to attack the planet.

episodes.name: The Power Transfer (2)
episodes.overview: Three departing Rangers transfer their powers to the new Rangers who are immediately called into battle against the Silver Horns Monster.

episodes.name: Goldar's Vice-Versa
episodes.overview: Adam discovers his attractive hiking partner is taking him on a trail to nowhere.

episodes.name: Mirror of Regret
episodes.overview: Zedd tries to use the Mirror of Regret to undermine Adam's confidence.

episodes.name: When is a Ranger Not a Ranger?
episodes.overview: Bulk and Skull must save the Power Rangers from the Scatterbrain Monster.

episodes.name: Rocky Just Wants to Have Fun
episodes.overview: Lord Zedd casts a spell on Rocky causing him to become obsessed with playing a pachinko game.

episodes.name: Lights, Camera, Action
episodes.overview: Lord Zedd tries to break into show biz, but the Rangers show him the true meaning of rejection.

episodes.name: Where There's Smoke, There's Fire
episodes.overview: Aisha learns the value of being part of a team when all the Rangers are needed to deal with the Flame Head Monster.

episodes.name: Scavenger Hunt
episodes.overview: Zedd turns the gang's scavenger hunt into a fight for survival.

episodes.name: The Great Bookala Escape
episodes.overview: The Rangers try to help Bookala, a friendly alien, return to his planet.

episodes.name: Forever Friends
episodes.overview: Zedd sends the huge Jaws of Destruction to destroy the Power Rangers.

episodes.name: A Reel Fish Story
episodes.overview: Zedd creates some underwater monsters to scare a young swimmer.

episodes.name: Rangers Back in Time (1)
episodes.overview: Zedd turns back time reverting the Rangers back into helpless children.

episodes.name: Rangers Back in Time (2)
episodes.overview: Alpha attempts to save the Power Rangers and restore them to their rightful ages.

episodes.name: The Wedding (1)
episodes.overview: Rita Repulsa drugs Lord Zedd with a love potion and launches her own attack against the Rangers.

episodes.name: The Wedding (2)
episodes.overview: Zedd proposes to Rita, and she promises to deliver the defeated Rangers as a wedding present.

episodes.name: The Wedding (3)
episodes.overview: Rita and Zedd marry and decide to spend their honeymoon destroying the Power Rangers.

episodes.name: Return of the Green Ranger (1)
episodes.overview: The Evil Green Ranger returns and Tommy is forced to confront him alone.

episodes.name: Return of the Green Ranger (2)
episodes.overview: The Rangers are stuck in the year 1774 and find they are unable to morph as the evil Green Ranger continues his destructive rampage.

episodes.name: Return of the Green Ranger (3)
episodes.overview: The world hangs in the balance as the White Ranger and Green Ranger face off in a final showdown.

episodes.name: Best Man for the Job
episodes.overview: Rita and Zedd turn the class election into an ugly rivalry for Kimberly and Tommy.

episodes.name: Storybook Rangers (1)
episodes.overview: Rita traps Kimberly, Tommy and Rocky inside a book of fairy tales.

episodes.name: Storybook Rangers (2)
episodes.overview: Fairy tale monsters prove to be a challenge for the Rangers.

episodes.name: Wild West Rangers (1)
episodes.overview: Kimberly is transported through a time hole to the 1800s where she meets the Power Rangers' wild west ancestors.

episodes.name: Wild West Rangers (2)
episodes.overview: Kimberly helps the Rangers' ancestors morph into "Wild West Rangers" to fight the Needle Nose monster and save the world.

episodes.name: Blue Ranger Gone Bad
episodes.overview: Rita and Zedd create an evil Blue Ranger from a high school art project.
